summary: Explored PortalSifast REST API and auth: Sanctum Bearer tokens only (no Passport/custom API-key middleware); routes live in routes/api.php with prefixes sifast/, admin/, informasi/, etc.; Form Requests under app/Http/Requests/Api/ with manual JSON envelopes (no Eloquent Resources); Telegram webhook is the main unauthenticated external integration. Proposed /api/agent/* endpoints have no path conflicts and fit cleanly as a new prefix; agent api_key auth from softwaremonitoring.md would be a new auth pattern alongside Sanctum.
current_status: Read-only API/auth exploration complete; findings ready for RS Agent API design. No code changes made.
